title: Modeling spatio-temporal locality in multi-step forecasting of geo-referenced time series
abstract: arXiv:2608.25698v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Forecasting future measurements from geographically distributed sensors is essential across many domains. However, the spatial distribution of these sensors raises multiple challenges, primarily due to spatial autocorrelation phenomena, that introduce inter-dependencies among nearby locations, that cannot therefore be treated independently. While some existing approaches can capture such phenomena, they generally model the spatial dimension globally across all locations. On the other hand, the method we propose in this paper, called SPALT, focuses on capturing spatial relationships among time series with similar trends, even if they occur at different times, thus modeling the spatio-temporal locality. translated_title: 地理参考时间序列多步预测中的时空局部性建模
translated_abstract: 从地理分布传感器预测未来测量值在许多领域至关重要。然而，这些传感器的空间分布带来了多重挑战，主要是由于空间自相关现象，这导致邻近位置之间存在相互依赖性，因此不能将它们独立处理。虽然一些现有方法能够捕捉此类现象，但它们通常在所有位置上全局地建模空间维度。另一方面，我们在本文中提出的方法，称为SPALT，专注于捕捉具有相似趋势的时间序列之间的空间关系，即使这些趋势发生在不同时间，从而建模时空局部性。SPALT利用线性模型树，这使我们能够在局部考虑空间自相关：在树构建过程中，所采用的启发式方法将具有相似趋势的时间序列分组到同一节点中，并在该节点上附加建模。
tldr: 本文提出SPALT方法，通过线性模型树在局部建模地理参考时间序列的时空局部性，捕捉相似趋势序列间的空间关系，区别于全局空间建模。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes SPALT, a method using linear model trees to locally model spatio-temporal locality in geo-referenced time series, capturing spatial relationships among series with similar trends, unlike global spatial modeling.
